# BuildDeed

> Software licenses as NFTs on NEAR testnet. One contract, licenses.builddeed.testnet, holds every license of every product and the SHA-256 of each official build. An agent can buy a license, register its computer and download a checked build with no browser.

- [Guide for agents](agents.md): views, the calls an agent makes, the owner's budget and key, the builddeed CLI, and what the download check proves.
- [Protocol spec](https://github.com/13rac1/builddeed-sdk/blob/main/spec/README.md): the computer id, the license check and the register link.
- [Contract source](https://github.com/13rac1/builddeed/blob/main/contract/src/lib.rs): the methods and their JSON.
- Contract on NEAR testnet: licenses.builddeed.testnet
- RPC: https://rpc.testnet.fastnear.com
